item.title: Capitals prospect Antoine Keller named to Team France’s roster for 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Antoine Keller is the first Washington Capitals-affiliated player to be officially named to their nation’s roster for the 2026 Winter Olympics. The 21-year-old goaltender was selected Tuesday as one of 24 players for France’s roster headed to Italy in February. Keller, born in Dijon, France, was the Capitals’ seventh-round pick in the 2023 NHL Draft.
